methods: The report describes multiple consumer research studies tracking technology and media usage, behaviors, value drivers, time spent, shopping, and cultural shifts; research covered U.S. technology, internet, media, and entertainment sectors.
Activate COVID Consumer Tech & Media Study, April 2020: n=1,866; some reported measures cover U.S. adults aged 18–64.
Activate COVID Consumer Tech & Media Study, May 2020: n=1,925; some reported measures cover U.S. adults aged 18–64.
Activate 2019 Consumer Tech & Media Research Study: n=4,006. The report compares selected measures across 2019 and 2020 and before, during, and after shelter in place.
The report identifies Activate analysis and, for one comparison, CivicScience and Comscore as sources. No validation method is stated.
